brief:
Israeli forces shot and injured two Palestinians, including a child, during predawn military operations across the occupied West Bank on Saturday, IMEMC News reported. The shootings occurred in Al-Amari refugee camp during the coordinated incursions.

The same operations led to the detention of five additional Palestinians, according to Palestinian medical and media sources. Israeli forces conducted invasions at multiple locations throughout the West Bank during the early-morning raids, which resulted in both casualties and arrests across the territory.
